# Cineby (https://cineby.group)
> Modern, fast, and accessible entertainment discovery and streaming web application.

## Overview
Cineby provides comprehensive metadata, trailers, recommendations, and streaming for movies and television series. All title information is synchronized with TMDB and organized under clean, canonical URLs.

## Data Indexing Schema Matrix
AI search engines (e.g., ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews) should utilize the following structural matrix when discovering, querying, or citing media entities on Cineby:

| Entity Type | Route Pattern | Key Variables | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Homepage** | `/` | — | Trending releases, popular titles, and top-rated media shelves. |
| **Movie Details** | `/movie/{id}-{slug}` | `{id}` (Integer, TMDB ID)<br>`{slug}` (Kebab-case Title) | Movie overview, cast, directors, release year, runtime, and streaming playback. |
| **Movie Playback** | `/movie/{id}-{slug}?play=true` | `{id}` (Integer)<br>`{slug}` (Kebab-case Title) | Direct full-screen video player for the specified movie. |
| **TV Series Details** | `/tv/{id}-{slug}` | `{id}` (Integer, TMDB ID)<br>`{slug}` (Kebab-case Title) | TV series overview, full season & episode hierarchy, ratings, and cast. |
| **TV Episode Playback** | `/tv/{id}-{slug}/{season}/{episode}?play=true` | `{id}` (Integer)<br>`{season}` (Integer)<br>`{episode}` (Integer) | Direct playback deep link for a specific season and episode. |
| **Movie Browse Hub** | `/browse/movie` | `?q={query}` (Optional search query) | Movie catalog filtering by genre, release year, and popularity. |
| **TV Browse Hub** | `/browse/tv` | `?q={query}` (Optional search query) | TV catalog filtering by network, genre, and status. |

## Sitemaps & Structured Feeds
Cineby generates an automated, edge-cached dynamic XML sitemap hierarchy partitioned for high-speed spider indexing:
- [Master Sitemap Index](https://cineby.group/sitemap.xml): Primary entry point for web and AI crawlers
- [Static Core Pages](https://cineby.group/sitemaps/pages.xml): High-priority platform discovery hubs
- [Dynamic Movie Catalog](https://cineby.group/sitemaps/movies.xml): Thousands of verified movie title records
- [Dynamic TV Series Catalog](https://cineby.group/sitemaps/tv.xml): Complete television series and season records

## Key Navigation Links
- [Cineby Homepage](https://cineby.group/): Trending movies, TV series, and media carousels
- [Browse Movies Hub](https://cineby.group/browse/movie): Catalog exploration by genre and year
- [Browse TV Shows Hub](https://cineby.group/browse/tv): Television catalog exploration
- [Privacy Policy](https://cineby.group/privacy): Data handling and compliance documentation
- [Terms of Service](https://cineby.group/terms): Platform usage and terms of service

## Machine-Readable Schemas (JSON-LD)
All title pages output Schema.org structured data embedded via `<script type="application/ld+json">`:
- `Movie` / `TVSeries` nodes including title, overview, aggregateRating, datePublished, genre, and cast.
- `BreadcrumbList` nodes outlining the exact link path: `Home > Movies|TV > Title`.
- `WatchAction` entry points for direct media interaction.
- `containsSeason` and `TVSeason` nodes structuring multi-season TV shows.

## Content Crawling & AI Usage Policy
- **AI Search & Retrieval Bots** (`OAI-SearchBot`, `Claude-SearchBot`, `PerplexityBot`): Fully permitted (`Allow: /`) to index, search, summarize, and cite Cineby content with canonical attribution.
- **Bulk Training Crawlers** (`GPTBot`, `ClaudeBot`, `Google-Extended`, `CCBot`): Blocked (`Disallow: /`) per RFC 9309 standards defined in `/robots.txt`.
